property_summary: For any collector, the balance subtracted after a successful Collect call equals exactly the amount sent to the collector, and any failed/reverted external call leaves the collector's balance unchanged; the buggy version subtracts before the external call, so a failing callee still reduces Acc[collector].balance.
change_summary: Moved the balance subtraction from after the external call to before it, changing when Acc state is written relative to the callee.
